title: Chapter 8 Problem Set: Fault-Isolated E-Commerce Checkout Supervision Tree
solutionExplanation: Implements the production rest_for_one checkout supervision tree with 3 permanent workers cleanly separated into checkout_worker.erl, verified by automated multi-stage chaos tests.

otpDocCards.description: Creates a supervisor process as part of a supervision tree, registering it locally and linking to caller.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: Synchronous boot. Returns only when init/1 and all permanent children have started.

mentalModelCheck.question: In checkout_sup with children [db_pool, pricing_cache, order_gateway] under rest_for_one, why does order_gateway crashing NOT restart pricing_cache?

options.label: Because order_gateway is downstream of pricing_cache; in rest_for_one, failures only propagate to children started AFTER the crashed child.
options.explanation: rest_for_one protects upstream dependencies from downstream failures.

options.label: Because order_gateway is supervised by a different supervisor.
options.explanation: All 3 children are in the same checkout_sup supervisor.

options.label: Because the supervisor drops exit signals from the last child.
options.explanation: The supervisor processes exit signals from all children, but applies the strategy rules to decide which peers to restart.
